endorsements.name: Chema Alonso
endorsements.label: Owning bad guys {and mafia} with javascript botnets
endorsements.description: Man in the middle attacks are still one of the most powerful techniques for owning machines. In this talk mitm schemas in anonymous services are going to be discussed. Then attendees will see how easily a botnet using javascript can be created to analyze that kind of connections and some of the actions of bad people, mafia, scammers, etc... behind those services are doing... in real. It promises to be funny
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2012

evidence-links.title: Black Hat USA 2012 - Owning Bad Guys (and Mafia) with Javascript Botnets

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
